eb92b70d9c02f7d9c21a630036cf7699371c4e7b.summary: A Telegram channel named for Shiny Hunters, Scattered Spider and Lapsus$ began listing breaches, leaked files and sale offers in August 2025. Victims named include Victoria's Secret, Gucci, Neiman Marcus, Chanel and Google. Government bodies, including the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the UK Ministry of Justice, were also targeted. The posts threatened leaks, mentioned ransomware under development, and referred to a possible Snowflake 3.0 campaign.

eb1800604354024c5c0f45099e608e652d12c055.summary: CERT-Yoroi analysis of threat group UNC1945, named by Mandiant, which the report says has targeted financial and banking institutions in Italy and Europe, tracked since at least 2015. The group uses a portable QEMU virtual machine carrying post-exploitation tools (credential harvesting, Mimikatz, EternalBlue exploits, Responder) against legacy systems. The report says attribution to Carbanak/Anunak is unconfirmed. Published November 30, 2020.
